entities.summary: The University of Kurdistan Hewlêr (UKH) is an educational institution in Erbil, the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. UKH is a public university that was established in 2006. The University of Kurdistan Hewlêr obtained top ranking throughout the Region in 2018. University of Kurdistan Hewler is a university in Erbil, established in 2006.
